what: A 6px dark dot sticks to the mouse position with no lag. Over links and buttons it grows to 28px, and over the left and right halves of the slider (the previous/next click zones) it grows to a 112px circle in .2s ease — the moment the cursor enters a half, a 29px arrow pointing that way appears inside the circle immediately, and it is removed immediately when the cursor leaves (only the graphic is swapped, no transition). The system cursor is left as is · with look: hollow, the dot becomes a 4px ring hollowed out at the same size over links, and with hide: 1 the system cursor is hidden (Brand 35px orange dot).

options.min: Off at this width (px) and below, default 900 — always off on touch devices and coarse pointers
options.links: Selector for spots that grow to 28px, default a, button, [data-fx-part=target]
options.[data-fx-part=prev]·[data-fx-part=next]: Half-press area over the slide panel (previous and next buttons of the slider on the user side) — it becomes an arrow circle there
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: (if present) a dot placed by hand — if absent the part creates and attaches one. The attached element must have no transform so the fixed dot is relative to the window
options.--fx-size·--fx-link·--fx-nav: Dot · over link · over half diameters (via style), default 6px·28px·112px
options.--fx-dot·--fx-arrow: Dot color · arrow color (via style), default --kf-ink · --kf-bg
options.look: With hollow, instead of growing over links it empties the inside and leaves only the border ring (background .2s, border immediately) — to keep the ring size unchanged, set --fx-link the same as --fx-size
options.--fx-ring: look: hollow ring thickness (via style), default 4px
options.hide: When 1, the system cursor is hidden over the panel and its links while the dot is attached, default 0
options.move: With transform, the dot position moves with transform translate instead of left · top (when the original moves with matrix), default left · top

from.where: shared.js and shared.css .vi-cursor (original main.js cursor - circle: .c_cursor 6px, a and button hover 28px, .mask-slider-prev and next hover 112px + arrow image 29px, width and height .2s ease, image opacity and transform .3s ease, (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and innerWidth > Only at 900)
shared.js .ys-cursor (original #cursor — a 20px ball graphic follows the mouse with no lag and scales to 1.5 over links, hidden on phones)
from.options: style="--fx-size: 20px; --fx-link: 30px" — The original uses a ball image instead of a dot (site CSS)

from.where: shared.js·shared.css body cursor (original magicMouse #magicPointer — a 35px orange dot placed straight at clientX·Y every frame, over .magic-hover it gets is-hover with a transparent background + a 4px orange border ring, transition background·width·height .2s, body cursor none, none at 1025px and below)
from.options: data-fx-grow-dot-cursor="look: hollow; hide: 1; min: 1025; move: transform; links: a:not([data-to-top]), button, [data-fx-part=target]" style="--fx-size: 35px; --fx-link: 35px; --fx-dot: var(--kf-accent)" — In the original only the top arrow is not .magic-hover, so there the dot stays as it is

note: The original CSS applies a .3s fade and a .8→1 scale to the arrow image, but the selector was wrongly hardened to .c_cursor__img.c_cursor__img so it is always visible. In practice it appears immediately when the image source is swapped, and the probe (motion-probe) also shows no arrow motion. Built to match that behavior.
